title: Verlinde lines, anyon permutations and commutant pairs inside $E_{8,1}$ CFT
summary: We develop a defect-theoretic refinement of meromorphic 2d CFTs in which the ordinary torus partition function -- often just the vacuum character -- does not reveal how states organize under symmetry lines. Our central proposal is an \emph{equatorial projection} framework: from a commutant decomposition into commuting rational chiral algebras with categories $\mathcal{C}$ and $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}$, we encode genus-one couplings by a non-negative integer matrix $M$ pairing characters and satisfying modular intertwiner relations.
